scenes.descriptionEn: Settles down and watches the world.

scenes.description: 轻轻晃一晃，向你打个招呼。
scenes.descriptionEn: Gives a little greeting, then settles down.

scenes.description: 往前挪一点，停下来看看四周。
scenes.descriptionEn: Moves forward a little and stops to look around.

scenes.description: 先看左边，再看右边。
scenes.descriptionEn: Looks left, then right.

scenes.description: 认真地点两下头。
scenes.descriptionEn: Two deliberate little nods.

scenes.description: 左右摇头，再看向你。
scenes.descriptionEn: Shakes its head, then looks back at you.

scenes.description: 歪着头凑近一点，好像发现了什么。
scenes.descriptionEn: Tilts its head and leans closer.

scenes.description: 突然一愣，往后缩一下，又小心地探头。
scenes.descriptionEn: Startles, pulls back, then takes another look.

scenes.description: 身子轻轻弹两下，开心地晃一晃。
scenes.descriptionEn: Two happy bounces and a little wiggle.

scenes.description: 低下头，悄悄抬眼看你。
scenes.descriptionEn: Looks down, then sneaks a glance at you.

scenes.description: 抬起头，得意地晃一晃。
scenes.descriptionEn: Lifts its head with a small, pleased sway.

scenes.description: 垂下头，慢慢缩成一团。
scenes.descriptionEn: Lowers its head and curls in a little.

scenes.description: 绷住身子，气呼呼地抖两下。
scenes.descriptionEn: Tenses up and gives two grumpy shakes.

scenes.description: 低头鞠个躬，再抬头看你。
scenes.descriptionEn: Bows, then looks up at you.

scenes.description: 精神一振，一下一下给你打气。
scenes.descriptionEn: Perks up and cheers you on.

scenes.description: 往前凑一点，送你一颗小爱心。
scenes.descriptionEn: Leans closer and sends a little heart.

scenes.description: 慢慢伸展开，再舒舒服服地收回来。
scenes.descriptionEn: Stretches out and settles comfortably.

scenes.description: 头往后仰，打完哈欠眯一下眼。
scenes.descriptionEn: Tips its head back for a yawn, then blinks.

scenes.description: 脑袋一点一点，差点睡着又抬起来。
scenes.descriptionEn: Nods off, catches itself, then droops again.

scenes.description: 安静睡着，身子随着呼吸轻轻起伏。
scenes.descriptionEn: Sleeps peacefully with a gentle breathing rhythm.

scenes.description: 睁开眼，伸展开，慢慢恢复精神。
scenes.descriptionEn: Opens its eyes, stretches, and slowly wakes up.

scenes.description: 低头整理自己，抖一抖再放松下来。
scenes.descriptionEn: Tidies itself, gives a shake, and settles.

scenes.description: 侧过身挠两下，终于舒服了。
scenes.descriptionEn: Turns to scratch an itch, then relaxes.

scenes.description: 先憋住，突然一个喷嚏，自己也愣住了。

scenes.description: 低头读书，翻过一页，接着往下看。
scenes.descriptionEn: Reads, turns a page, and keeps going.

scenes.description: 凑近信封，打开后认真看一看。
scenes.descriptionEn: Leans toward an envelope and looks inside.

scenes.description: 在纸上画几笔，退后看看自己的作品。

scenes.description: 跟着拍子点头，越听越投入。
scenes.descriptionEn: Nods to the beat and gets into the music.

scenes.description: 左右交替敲出一段小节奏。

scenes.description: 碰一下小球，看它滚远，再把它拦住。
scenes.descriptionEn: Nudges a ball, watches it roll, and stops it.

scenes.description: 跟着泡泡往上看，破掉时眨一下眼。

scenes.description: 跟着蝴蝶转头，扑了个空。
scenes.descriptionEn: Follows a butterfly and just misses it.

scenes.description: 抬头等叶子落下来，再轻轻碰一碰。
scenes.descriptionEn: Watches a leaf fall and gives it a gentle nudge.

scenes.description: 凑近闻一闻，满足地闭上眼。
scenes.descriptionEn: Leans in to smell a flower and closes its eyes.

scenes.description: 试着碰一下水，溅起来后赶紧缩回去。
scenes.descriptionEn: Tests the water and pulls back from the splash.

scenes.description: 往伞下面挪一挪，听雨落下来。
scenes.descriptionEn: Moves under an umbrella and listens to the rain.

scenes.description: 被风吹得歪一下，稳住后抖掉一片叶子。

scenes.description: 抬头看着星星，轻轻伸过去。
scenes.descriptionEn: Looks up at a star and reaches toward it.

scenes.description: 看灯笼左右摇，脑袋也跟着摆。
scenes.descriptionEn: Watches a lantern sway from side to side.

scenes.description: 小心碰开盒盖，惊喜地往里看。
scenes.descriptionEn: Lifts the lid and peeks inside with delight.

scenes.description: 凑近吃一小口，满足地晃一下。
scenes.descriptionEn: Takes a small bite and gives a contented wiggle.

scenes.description: 低头喝一口，再抬起头慢慢咽下。
scenes.descriptionEn: Leans down for a sip, then lifts its head.

scenes.description: 晃到左边又晃到右边，总算稳住了。
scenes.descriptionEn: Wobbles left and right, then finds its balance.

scenes.description: 从叶子后面探头，停一下，又缩回去。
scenes.descriptionEn: Peeks out from behind a leaf, pauses, and hides again.

scenes.description: 盯住飘动的丝带，追过去又扑了个空。

scenes.description: 缩到叶子后面，忍不住又偷偷看一眼。

scenes.description: 晃一晃道个晚安，靠着小枕头慢慢闭上眼。
scenes.descriptionEn: Gives a little sway, then rests against a pillow.

scenes.description: 身子轻轻一弹，跟着彩纸转一转。

scenes.description: 在纸上画几笔，退后看看自己的作品。
scenes.descriptionEn: Makes a few marks, then pulls back to admire them.

scenes.description: 跟着拍子点头，越听越投入。
scenes.descriptionEn: Nods to the beat and gets into the music.

scenes.description: 左右交替敲出一段小节奏。
scenes.descriptionEn: Taps out a short rhythm, left then right.

scenes.description: 碰一下小球，看它滚远，再把它拦住。
scenes.descriptionEn: Nudges a ball, watches it roll, and stops it.

scenes.description: 跟着泡泡往上看，破掉时眨一下眼。
scenes.descriptionEn: Follows a bubble upward and blinks when it pops.

scenes.description: 跟着蝴蝶转头，扑了个空。
scenes.descriptionEn: Follows a butterfly and just misses it.

scenes.description: 抬头等叶子落下来，再轻轻碰一碰。
scenes.descriptionEn: Watches a leaf fall and gives it a gentle nudge.

scenes.description: 凑近闻一闻，满足地闭上眼。
scenes.descriptionEn: Leans in to smell a flower and closes its eyes.

scenes.description: 试着碰一下水，溅起来后赶紧缩回去。
scenes.descriptionEn: Tests the water and pulls back from the splash.

scenes.description: 往伞下面挪一挪，听雨落下来。
scenes.descriptionEn: Moves under an umbrella and listens to the rain.

scenes.description: 被风吹得歪一下，稳住后抖掉一片叶子。
scenes.descriptionEn: Leans into the wind, then shakes off a leaf.

scenes.description: 抬头看着星星，轻轻伸过去。
scenes.descriptionEn: Looks up at a star and reaches toward it.

scenes.description: 看灯笼左右摇，脑袋也跟着摆。
scenes.descriptionEn: Watches a lantern sway from side to side.

scenes.description: 小心碰开盒盖，惊喜地往里看。
scenes.descriptionEn: Lifts the lid and peeks inside with delight.

scenes.description: 凑近吃一小口，满足地晃一下。
scenes.descriptionEn: Takes a small bite and gives a contented wiggle.

scenes.description: 低头喝一口，再抬起头慢慢咽下。
scenes.descriptionEn: Leans down for a sip, then lifts its head.

scenes.description: 晃到左边又晃到右边，总算稳住了。
scenes.descriptionEn: Wobbles left and right, then finds its balance.

scenes.description: 从叶子后面探头，停一下，又缩回去。
scenes.descriptionEn: Peeks out from behind a leaf, pauses, and hides again.

scenes.description: 盯住飘动的丝带，追过去又扑了个空。
scenes.descriptionEn: Chases a fluttering ribbon and just misses it.

scenes.description: 缩到叶子后面，忍不住又偷偷看一眼。
scenes.descriptionEn: Hides behind a leaf, then sneaks another look.

scenes.description: 晃一晃道个晚安，靠着小枕头慢慢闭上眼。
scenes.descriptionEn: Gives a little sway, then rests against a pillow.

scenes.description: 身子轻轻一弹，跟着彩纸转一转。
scenes.descriptionEn: Bounces and turns as confetti falls.

scenes.description: 放松下来，看看四周。
scenes.descriptionEn: Settles down and watches the world.

scenes.description: 轻轻晃一晃，向你打个招呼。
scenes.descriptionEn: Gives a little greeting, then settles down.

scenes.description: 往前挪一点，停下来看看四周。
scenes.descriptionEn: Moves forward a little and stops to look around.

scenes.description: 先看左边，再看右边。
scenes.descriptionEn: Looks left, then right.

scenes.description: 认真地点两下头。
scenes.descriptionEn: Two deliberate little nods.

scenes.description: 左右摇头，再看向你。
scenes.descriptionEn: Shakes its head, then looks back at you.

scenes.description: 歪着头凑近一点，好像发现了什么。
scenes.descriptionEn: Tilts its head and leans closer.

scenes.description: 突然一愣，往后缩一下，又小心地探头。
scenes.descriptionEn: Startles, pulls back, then takes another look.

scenes.description: 身子轻轻弹两下，开心地晃一晃。
scenes.descriptionEn: Two happy bounces and a little wiggle.

scenes.description: 低下头，悄悄抬眼看你。
scenes.descriptionEn: Looks down, then sneaks a glance at you.

scenes.description: 抬起头，得意地晃一晃。
scenes.descriptionEn: Lifts its head with a small, pleased sway.

scenes.description: 垂下头，慢慢缩成一团。
scenes.descriptionEn: Lowers its head and curls in a little.

scenes.description: 绷住身子，气呼呼地抖两下。
scenes.descriptionEn: Tenses up and gives two grumpy shakes.

scenes.description: 低头鞠个躬，再抬头看你。
scenes.descriptionEn: Bows, then looks up at you.

scenes.description: 精神一振，一下一下给你打气。
scenes.descriptionEn: Perks up and cheers you on.

scenes.description: 往前凑一点，送你一颗小爱心。
scenes.descriptionEn: Leans closer and sends a little heart.

scenes.description: 慢慢伸展开，再舒舒服服地收回来。
scenes.descriptionEn: Stretches out and settles comfortably.

scenes.description: 头往后仰，打完哈欠眯一下眼。
scenes.descriptionEn: Tips its head back for a yawn, then blinks.

scenes.description: 脑袋一点一点，差点睡着又抬起来。
scenes.descriptionEn: Nods off, catches itself, then droops again.

scenes.description: 安静睡着，身子随着呼吸轻轻起伏。
scenes.descriptionEn: Sleeps peacefully with a gentle breathing rhythm.

scenes.description: 睁开眼，伸展开，慢慢恢复精神。
scenes.descriptionEn: Opens its eyes, stretches, and slowly wakes up.

scenes.description: 低头整理自己，抖一抖再放松下来。
scenes.descriptionEn: Tidies itself, gives a shake, and settles.

scenes.description: 侧过身挠两下，终于舒服了。
scenes.descriptionEn: Turns to scratch an itch, then relaxes.

scenes.description: 先憋住，突然一个喷嚏，自己也愣住了。
scenes.descriptionEn: Holds it in, sneezes, then looks a little surprised.

scenes.description: 低头读书，翻过一页，接着往下看。
scenes.descriptionEn: Reads, turns a page, and keeps going.

scenes.descriptionEn: Makes a few marks, then pulls back to admire them.

scenes.description: 跟着拍子点头，越听越投入。
scenes.descriptionEn: Nods to the beat and gets into the music.

scenes.description: 左右交替敲出一段小节奏。
scenes.descriptionEn: Taps out a short rhythm, left then right.

scenes.description: 碰一下小球，看它滚远，再把它拦住。
scenes.descriptionEn: Nudges a ball, watches it roll, and stops it.

scenes.description: 跟着泡泡往上看，破掉时眨一下眼。
scenes.descriptionEn: Follows a bubble upward and blinks when it pops.

scenes.description: 跟着蝴蝶转头，扑了个空。
scenes.descriptionEn: Follows a butterfly and just misses it.

scenes.description: 抬头等叶子落下来，再轻轻碰一碰。
scenes.descriptionEn: Watches a leaf fall and gives it a gentle nudge.

scenes.description: 凑近闻一闻，满足地闭上眼。
scenes.descriptionEn: Leans in to smell a flower and closes its eyes.

scenes.description: 试着碰一下水，溅起来后赶紧缩回去。
scenes.descriptionEn: Tests the water and pulls back from the splash.

scenes.description: 往伞下面挪一挪，听雨落下来。
scenes.descriptionEn: Moves under an umbrella and listens to the rain.

scenes.description: 被风吹得歪一下，稳住后抖掉一片叶子。
scenes.descriptionEn: Leans into the wind, then shakes off a leaf.

scenes.description: 抬头看着星星，轻轻伸过去。
scenes.descriptionEn: Looks up at a star and reaches toward it.

scenes.description: 看灯笼左右摇，脑袋也跟着摆。
scenes.descriptionEn: Watches a lantern sway from side to side.

scenes.description: 小心碰开盒盖，惊喜地往里看。
scenes.descriptionEn: Lifts the lid and peeks inside with delight.

scenes.description: 凑近吃一小口，满足地晃一下。
scenes.descriptionEn: Takes a small bite and gives a contented wiggle.

scenes.description: 低头喝一口，再抬起头慢慢咽下。
scenes.descriptionEn: Leans down for a sip, then lifts its head.

scenes.description: 晃到左边又晃到右边，总算稳住了。
scenes.descriptionEn: Wobbles left and right, then finds its balance.

scenes.description: 从叶子后面探头，停一下，又缩回去。
scenes.descriptionEn: Peeks out from behind a leaf, pauses, and hides again.

scenes.description: 盯住飘动的丝带，追过去又扑了个空。
scenes.descriptionEn: Chases a fluttering ribbon and just misses it.

scenes.description: 缩到叶子后面，忍不住又偷偷看一眼。
scenes.descriptionEn: Hides behind a leaf, then sneaks another look.

scenes.description: 晃一晃道个晚安，靠着小枕头慢慢闭上眼。
scenes.descriptionEn: Gives a little sway, then rests against a pillow.

scenes.description: 身子轻轻一弹，跟着彩纸转一转。
scenes.descriptionEn: Bounces and turns as confetti falls.

scenes.description: 放松下来，看看四周。
scenes.descriptionEn: Settles down and watches the world.

scenes.description: 轻轻晃一晃，向你打个招呼。
scenes.descriptionEn: Gives a little greeting, then settles down.

scenes.description: 往前挪一点，停下来看看四周。
scenes.descriptionEn: Moves forward a little and stops to look around.

scenes.description: 先看左边，再看右边。
scenes.descriptionEn: Looks left, then right.

scenes.description: 认真地点两下头。
scenes.descriptionEn: Two deliberate little nods.

scenes.description: 左右摇头，再看向你。
scenes.descriptionEn: Shakes its head, then looks back at you.

scenes.description: 歪着头凑近一点，好像发现了什么。
scenes.descriptionEn: Tilts its head and leans closer.

scenes.description: 突然一愣，往后缩一下，又小心地探头。
scenes.descriptionEn: Startles, pulls back, then takes another look.

scenes.description: 身子轻轻弹两下，开心地晃一晃。
scenes.descriptionEn: Two happy bounces and a little wiggle.

scenes.description: 低下头，悄悄抬眼看你。
scenes.descriptionEn: Looks down, then sneaks a glance at you.

scenes.description: 抬起头，得意地晃一晃。
scenes.descriptionEn: Lifts its head with a small, pleased sway.

scenes.description: 垂下头，慢慢缩成一团。
scenes.descriptionEn: Lowers its head and curls in a little.

scenes.description: 绷住身子，气呼呼地抖两下。
scenes.descriptionEn: Tenses up and gives two grumpy shakes.

scenes.description: 低头鞠个躬，再抬头看你。
scenes.descriptionEn: Bows, then looks up at you.

scenes.description: 精神一振，一下一下给你打气。
scenes.descriptionEn: Perks up and cheers you on.

scenes.description: 往前凑一点，送你一颗小爱心。
scenes.descriptionEn: Leans closer and sends a little heart.

scenes.description: 慢慢伸展开，再舒舒服服地收回来。
scenes.descriptionEn: Stretches out and settles comfortably.

scenes.description: 头往后仰，打完哈欠眯一下眼。
scenes.descriptionEn: Tips its head back for a yawn, then blinks.

scenes.description: 脑袋一点一点，差点睡着又抬起来。
scenes.descriptionEn: Nods off, catches itself, then droops again.

scenes.description: 安静睡着，身子随着呼吸轻轻起伏。
scenes.descriptionEn: Sleeps peacefully with a gentle breathing rhythm.

scenes.description: 睁开眼，伸展开，慢慢恢复精神。
scenes.descriptionEn: Opens its eyes, stretches, and slowly wakes up.

scenes.description: 低头整理自己，抖一抖再放松下来。
scenes.descriptionEn: Tidies itself, gives a shake, and settles.

scenes.description: 侧过身挠两下，终于舒服了。
scenes.descriptionEn: Turns to scratch an itch, then relaxes.

scenes.description: 先憋住，突然一个喷嚏，自己也愣住了。
scenes.descriptionEn: Holds it in, sneezes, then looks a little surprised.

scenes.description: 低头读书，翻过一页，接着往下看。
scenes.descriptionEn: Reads, turns a page, and keeps going.

scenes.description: 凑近信封，打开后认真看一看。
